title: Hatch configuration
description: Project policy for `hatch generate`. Only the generate side is configurable: a .md patch is a public contract and must mean the same thing on every machine, so nothing here changes how `apply` reads an existing patch.

out.description: Default place for the generated .md: a file path is taken as is, a directory (existing, or ending with a slash) gets <name of --in>.md inside it. null — next to --in.

mirror.description: Keep patches in a tree of their own: the .md goes to <out>/<path of the file inside the repository>.md, and missing directories are created. Requires "out" to name a directory; a relative one is taken from the repository root. Paths are measured from the nearest ancestor holding .git, so a file outside any repository is an error.

language.description: Default language; null — inferred from the extension of --in.

exact.description: Require the new file to be reproduced byte for byte.

bridgeGap.description: Stitch edits split by up to n unchanged non-blank lines back into a single hunk.

min.description: Enclosing blocks every generated pattern carries. 0 allows structureless anchors.

max.description: Cap on climbing up the enclosing blocks; "all" means up to the outermost.

base.description: Bracket levels spelled out in parent headers, counting from the outermost: 0 gives foo( ... ), 1 gives foo(bar( ... )). The readable baseline; on an ambiguous anchor the ladder unfolds further by itself, one named bracket at a time.

required.description: Fail instead of emitting the last-resort pattern that carries no parent at all.

min.description: Neighbouring significant lines every pattern carries, per side.

max.description: Cap of neighbouring significant lines per side; 0 forbids leaning on neighbours at all.

base.description: Bracket levels spelled out in neighbour anchors. On an ambiguous anchor the ladder unfolds further by itself, one named bracket at a time.
